mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate near zero lower bound compresses risk-free discount rates, reducing equity valuation costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points in one month signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE increased by >0.5pp in prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below 6-month moving averages indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to revenue contraction expectations.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both below 6-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are below 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) during manufacturing contraction phases signals reduced corporate output capacity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 100 periods, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly low federal funds rate (<0.5%) and low CPI inflation (<2.0% annualized) signal accommodative monetary policy with stable pricing, supporting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL annualized change < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) indicates persistent consumer spending weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating job losses exceeding 100,000 monthly (PAYEMS decline >100,000) signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where PAYEMS declines by >100,000 jobs in prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index) indicate severe manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has been below 95.0 for two consecutive months.
